name: hol-guard
description: Run HOL Guard MCP over stdio using the pinned Python package, or an existing HOL Guard CLI installation.

cli.description: Uses an existing HOL Guard CLI on PATH; this configuration does not install the binary or enable enforcement.

uvx.description: Resolves and runs the pinned HOL Guard Python package in an isolated uv tool environment when launched, downloading it if needed. Requires uv and Python 3.10+. Does not enable enforcement or install AI-agent hooks.
